Status: wave 341: 19 HawkNET en/<>c formatters named from the property table in en::.cctor

Method.evidence: en::.cctor builds the device-info property table; each entry calls Resources::get_DeviceInfoItem_<Property> immediately before ldftn of its display formatter and stores the delegate in a Class332 property description. 35 properties appear in the table; 19 have exactly one formatter, and those are named Format<Property>. The remaining 16 properties have two formatters each and need a per-pair body comparison. One row (0x060000E9) previously carried the weaker wave-340 name FormatManufacturerDataName and is now FormatDeviceManufacturerId, the property the table registers it for.
Method.themes: The table IS the owner map for en/<>c: no per-lambda guessing. perf-now/en-table.py recovers it from one --inspect-methods of en::.cctor.
